title: Parts of the Guitar
description: Learn the anatomy of a guitar — headstock, tuning pegs, nut, frets, body, bridge, and strings.

title: Reading Guitar Tabs
description: Understand how to read guitar tablature — the 6 lines represent the 6 strings, numbers indicate frets.

title: Your First 3 Chords: Em, Am, E
description: Master three essential chords that unlock hundreds of songs. These are the easiest chords to start with.

title: The G-C-D Trio
description: G, C, and D are the most common chords in popular music. Master these and you can play thousands of songs.

title: Basic Strumming Patterns
description: Learn the D-DU-UDU strumming pattern and how to keep rhythm. This pattern works for most Hindi songs.

title: Introduction to Barre Chords
description: Barre chords are the gateway to playing in any key. F major is the classic challenge — let's tackle it.

title: Fingerpicking Basics
description: Fingerpicking adds emotion and texture. Learn the p-i-m-a finger assignments and your first fingerpicking pattern.

title: Playing Tum Hi Ho
description: Put it all together with one of India's most loved songs. Am-F-C-G with capo 4.
